title: idenso
description: A library for representing and manipulating tensor identities with Symbolica, including Dirac algebra, color algebra, and tensor simplification routines for high-energy physics.
notes: Idenso-authored source is available under the MIT License. Library consumers must configure their own Symbolica license; GammaLoop's OEM license does not transfer to standalone idenso use. Symbolica and other third-party software remain governed by their own terms.
